explanation: Oscar Niemeyer designed the Sambadrome, opened in 1984. Each school, usually rooted in one neighbourhood, spends months preparing its music, costumes and floats for a single judged parade.

claims.text: At Rio de Janeiro's Carnival, samba schools compete in the judged parades at the Sambadrome.
Sports clubs, military bands and trade unions do not compete in the Sambadrome parades.
Oscar Niemeyer designed Rio de Janeiro's Sambadrome, which opened in 1984.
Samba schools are usually rooted in particular neighbourhoods of Rio de Janeiro.
Each samba school prepares its music, costumes and floats for months for one judged parade.
